tv_academy_debate.2000 = {
	type = country_event
	title = tv_academy_debate.2000.t
	desc = tv_academy_debate.2000.d
	outcome = neutral

	trigger = {
		var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
		var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 1
		tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
		NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
		NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
		NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }
	}
	option = {
		name = tv_academy_debate.2000.a
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
				var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 1
				tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
				NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }
			}
			tv_academy_debate_change_local_progress_effect = { value = 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 9 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_stance value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_cooldown value = 12 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group ?= 9 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_stance value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_cooldown value = 12 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group ?= 9 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_stance value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_cooldown value = 12 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group ?= 9 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_stance value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_cooldown value = 12 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group ?= 9 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_stance value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_cooldown value = 12 }
			}
			tv_academy_philosophy_check_debate_endpoint_effect = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = tv_academy_debate.2000.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
				var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 1
				tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
				NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }
			}
			tv_academy_debate_change_local_progress_effect = { value = -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 10 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_stance value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_cooldown value = 12 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group ?= 10 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_stance value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_cooldown value = 12 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group ?= 10 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_stance value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_cooldown value = 12 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group ?= 10 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_stance value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_cooldown value = 12 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group ?= 10 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_stance value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_cooldown value = 12 }
			}
			tv_academy_philosophy_check_debate_endpoint_effect = yes
		}
	}
